name: Cao Pi
title: The Successor of the Domineer

skills.name: Scavenge
skills.text: You can acquire all the cards of players that died.

skills.name: Banish
skills.text: Every instance after you suffer damage, you can make another player draw X cards (X being the units of health you have lost thus far), then that player stacks/unstacks his/her character cards.

differenceFromNormal: The term “immediately” is removed to clarify the timing of activating “Scavenge”. The ability description of “Banish” has been changed from “flip his/her character card” to “stack/unstack your character card”. The Ruler Ability is removed.
